comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Out of curiosity, I put the Japanese name of this map through a google search and started skimming translated sites. Most of the results were talking about how rare this map is; one poster claimed to have gotten it after 600+ runs, while another said they got it on their 47th run. Looks like the "quickest" way to grab it was to solo the dungeon, to reduce the number of enemies on that spawn (particularly on the boss floor) and thus slightly raise your odds of getting it as a drop reward from the boss.

Should be a lot of fun when I eventually get around to looking for it, heh. On the bright side, I haven't seen any information that suggests it's a one-time only drop, so far.
